findings.issue: צִיץ (H6731, masc. sg. construct) licenses blossom, plate, or wing; «diadema» narrows it to a crown, which that lemma does not carry.

notes: The two qal wayyiqtols, repeated turban, עַל־רֹאשׁוֹ, אֶל־מוּל פָּנָיו, נֵזֶר הַקֹּדֶשׁ, and the piel command to Moisés stay within the tokens.
